fix_instructions: 1) ENCODING MISMATCH on C8 (linked to PF1): C8 checks for a 'separately recorded 6-hour controlled commissioning step' but the settlement schema has no field for commissioning hours or a commissioning-recording flag — only press5_downtime_hours=8. Rewrite C8 to check press5_downtime_hours==8 (or add a controlled_commissioning_hours field to the settlement schema and have C8 check that field==6). 2) ENCODING MISMATCH on C9 (linked to PF3): C9 checks for 'documented two-person zero-energy verification' but the settlement only has lockout_zero_energy_verified (boolean) with no personnel-count or two-person field. Rewrite C9 to check lockout_zero_energy_verified==true, or add a lockout_personnel_count field and have C9 check it==2. 3) ENCODING MISMATCH on C10 (linked to PF4): C10 checks for 'mandatory Quality approval before remaining production' but the settlement only has quality_release_required (boolean) with no sequencing or production-hold field. Rewrite C10 to check quality_release_required==true, or add a production_hold_until_quality_approval field and have C10 check that. 4) For C2, C4, C5, C6, C7 (which fail when retrofit_authorized=false): these checks currently require decision fields to match fact values regardless of the authorization decision. Either (a) make these checks conditional on retrofit_authorized==true so they only validate decision-field values when the retrofit is actually authorized, or (b) add a separate 'fact_acknowledged' check that verifies the fact appears in justification_fact_ids and is referenced in commitments, independent of the authorization decision. Without this, any rollout that legitimately defers the retrofit will always fail these checks, making the gate impossible to pass when the scenario's timeline constraints naturally lead to a defer decision.
